messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Problem with MSstats v 3 in Skyline Daily (64-bit) 3.1.7317
parts:
Hi Scott,

Thank you for informing this error. I will fix this problem. Here is the temporary solution.

what I understand about this error is that 'gi|358437950|Calcium-activated' protein can not fit the survival model to handle censored missing value because of the missing pattern. so could you run the line below before 'dataProcess' function?

raw<-raw[raw$ProteinName!="gi|358437950|Calcium-activated",]

then, quant<-dataProcess(raw, ...)

hope to help. I will post the release use after I update new version.

-Meena

messages.subject: Re: Problem with MSstats v 3 in Skyline Daily (64-bit) 3.1.7317

Scott
